senses.gloss: Auṣaḍhi(n), or ˚dhi(n), n. of a Tathāgata: Mv 〔iii.236.10, 11〕. Senart reads ˚ḍhim, acc., and ˚ḍhī, nom.; but v.l. ˚dhaṃ (read ˚dhiṃ) and ˚dhī resp., which are surely to be read.
auṣarya (nt.; Skt. ūṣara plus -ya; unrecorded), salty ground: Mmk 〔113.11〕 ausarye sikatāstīrṇe tathaiva ca.
